headline: Goldiam International's brand Origem aims for ₹600-800 crore in revenue over five years
hook: An ambitious five-year goal for Origem
summary: Goldiam International's retail jewellery brand Origem has set a target to achieve ₹600 to ₹800 crore in revenue over the next five years. This projection outlines the growth trajectory and expansion plans for the company's branded retail segment. Indian retail investors tracking Goldiam can assess the long-term contribution of the Origem brand to the parent company's overall financial performance.
whats_next: Quarterly financial results tracking Origem's revenue contribution
why_it_matters: Long-term revenue visibility for Goldiam's retail jewellery segment.
